name: Nagad Merchant Gateway
author: Alom's English Center
description: Admin-managed Nagad merchant credential vault with encrypted API/signing keys and environment selection. Checkout adapter is enabled only after matching the merchant's official integration profile and sandbox verification.

settings_schema.label: Nagad Environment
settings_schema.help: Keep Sandbox selected until your assigned Nagad sandbox profile has passed end-to-end verification.

settings_schema.label: Merchant ID (if issued)
settings_schema.help: Merchant ID supplied in your Nagad merchant onboarding pack.

settings_schema.label: API Key / Client ID (if issued)
settings_schema.help: Client/API key if your assigned Nagad integration profile uses one. Encrypted at rest.

settings_schema.label: API Secret (if issued)
settings_schema.help: API secret if issued. Encrypted at rest.

settings_schema.label: API Username (if issued)
settings_schema.help: Merchant API username if supplied by Nagad. Encrypted at rest.

settings_schema.label: API Password (if issued)
settings_schema.help: Merchant API password if supplied by Nagad. Encrypted at rest.

settings_schema.label: Signing Private Key (if required by provider)
settings_schema.help: Merchant signing private key or PEM content if required by your assigned API profile. Encrypted at rest.

settings_schema.label: Provider Public Key / Certificate (if required)
settings_schema.help: Nagad/PG public key or certificate used to verify signed responses. Encrypted at rest.
